description.value: You press a seed into the body of a creature you can touch. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the seed embeds itself inside them. A creature with a seed embedded in them takes 3d4 necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns, and you gain an equal amount of temporary hit points. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.\n\nAt higher levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of Level 3 or higher, this spell deals an additional 1d4 necrotic damage for each slot level above 2nd.
